records.source: Order the pages by annotation: by class label, with unlabelled crops last or first and each class's suggestions after its answers, or by the last model's probability. The order stays while you page through; a crop you label moves when the pages are next read, for example when the order is chosen again.
records.translation: Raðaðu síðunum eftir merkingu: eftir flokki, með ómerkta myndskurði síðast eða fyrst og tillögur hvers flokks á eftir svörum hans, eða eftir líkindum síðasta líkans. Röðin helst á meðan þú flettir; myndskurður sem þú merkir færist þegar síðurnar eru næst lesnar, til dæmis þegar röðin er valin aftur.

records.source: Out-of-fold probability of the labelled class

records.key: Precision: of the crops the model calls a class, the share that are that class. Recall: of the crops of a class, the share the model finds. F1 score: the harmonic mean of precision and recall. Support: how many labelled crops of the class were scored. Accuracy: the share of all labelled crops predicted correctly; balanced accuracy is the mean recall over classes, so a large class cannot carry it. The majority-class baseline is the control: it suggests the largest class for every crop. Every labelled crop is predicted by a model fitted without it (stratified k-fold cross-validation).
records.source: Precision: of the crops the model calls a class, the share that are that class. Recall: of the crops of a class, the share the model finds. F1 score: the harmonic mean of precision and recall. Support: how many labelled crops of the class were scored. Accuracy: the share of all labelled crops predicted correctly; balanced accuracy is the mean recall over classes, so a large class cannot carry it. The majority-class baseline is the control: it suggests the largest class for every crop. Every labelled crop is predicted by a model fitted without it (stratified k-fold cross-validation).
records.translation: Nákvæmni (precision): af myndskurðunum sem líkanið kallar tiltekinn flokk, hlutfallið sem tilheyrir þeim flokki. Heimt (recall): af myndskurðum flokks, hlutfallið sem líkanið finnur. F1-gildi: hnitmiðað meðaltal (harmónískt) nákvæmni og heimtar. Fjöldi: hversu margir merktir myndskurðir flokksins voru metnir. Réttleiki (accuracy): hlutfall allra merktra myndskurða sem var spáð rétt; jafnaður réttleiki er meðalheimt yfir flokka, svo stór flokkur geti ekki borið hann uppi. Grunnlína stærsta flokks er viðmiðið: hún stingur upp á stærsta flokknum fyrir alla myndskurði. Hverjum merktum myndskurði er spáð af líkani sem var lagað án hans (lagskipt k-földuð krossgilding).

records.key: Run Suggest first; the model window describes its last run.
records.source: Run Suggest first; the model window describes its last run.
records.translation: Keyrðu Stinga upp á fyrst; líkanglugginn lýsir síðustu keyrslu.

records.key: Show what the last Suggest model was fitted on, how it scores on your own labels by cross-validation, and the thresholds that decide which crops get a suggestion. Moving a threshold updates the suggestions on the pages at once, without fitting again.
records.source: Show what the last Suggest model was fitted on, how it scores on your own labels by cross-validation, and the thresholds that decide which crops get a suggestion. Moving a threshold updates the suggestions on the pages at once, without fitting again.
records.translation: Sýnir hverju síðasta tillögulíkan var lagað að, hvernig það stendur sig á þínum eigin merkingum samkvæmt krossgildingu, og þröskuldana sem ráða því hvaða myndskurðir fá tillögu. Þegar þröskuldur er færður uppfærast tillögurnar á síðunum strax, án þess að laga líkanið aftur.
Stinga upp á flokki {b} frá líkindum
